title: Explore: the five money connection kinds, R36
prior_work: Meet R36 only: the connection kinds are five money families (money_transfer, money_payment, money_contribution, money_revenue, money_other) in place of money_flow. The kinds are registered by the money module (bio-plane/src/money/vocab.mjs and index.mjs); this module's flowsFrom preset (bio-plane/src/explore/presets.mjs) reads them by owner money. The test.todo for R36 in bio-plane/test/m/explore/chains.test.mjs becomes real tests (each of the five kinds is walked by flowsFrom and money_flow is no longer a kind; control: R16, R17 and R35 answer as before), make them pass inside bio-plane/src/explore/, and when R36 is met clear its '(not yet met: T53)' mark yourself (REQ-4). If meeting it needs a change in bio-plane/src/money/, bio-plane/src/op-declarations/ or any other module, do not edit it: say so to your coordinator in your receipt's not-verified list. Where build/situations/job.md names the old tool (proc), follow this START's commands instead. No earlier unmerged work touches this module.
